concerns.text: FR-001 requires parsing trajectories to extract 'ground-truth memory layer utility' via ablation. While T008/T008b perform ablation, T006 (Parser) is tasked to extract 'legal move distributions' and 'move entropy' but does NOT explicitly include the extraction of 'ground-truth memory layer utility' or the ablation results in its output schema (`metrics_with_moves.csv`). The FR-001 requirement to extract utility in the parsing phase is not covered by a specific task output, creating a gap in the data flow for FR-001.

FR-006 mandates validating the proxy assumption (static-log-derived utility vs. ablation-derived utility) on a hold-out set of at least 20 trajectories. T014 performs the correlation check, but T007c (Proxy Extractor) is tasked to extract 'static-log-derived utility' from `data/processed/metrics_with_moves.csv`. However, T006 (Parser) does not extract 'static-log-derived utility' (frequency of layer retrieval) from the raw logs; it only extracts 'legal moves' and 'entropy'. There is no task defined to parse the raw trajectory logs to extract the 'frequency of layer retrieval' required for the proxy input in T007c.

FR-001 requires extracting 'ground-truth memory layer utility' defined as 'measured impact on win rate when a specific layer is removed'. T008/T008b generate these labels via ablation, but the task descriptions for T006 (Parser) and T007c (Proxy Extractor) do not mention extracting or handling the 'layer removal' logic or the resulting 'win rate impact' in the initial parsing phase. The FR-001 requirement to 'extract... ground-truth memory layer utility' is partially unmet as the extraction logic is split between T008 (ablation) and T007c (proxy) without a unified extraction task for the raw data that FR-001 implies.

SC-002 requires verifying a token reduction of 'at least 30%'. T022a calculates the reduction and sets a `passed` flag, but there is no task explicitly defined to 'report' or 'flag' the failure of this specific 30% threshold in the final output as a distinct success/failure metric for SC-002, other than the boolean in T022a. While T028 includes `token_reduction_passed`, the specific requirement to 'verify' the 30% threshold as a pass/fail gate for the feature (SC-002) is only partially covered by T022a's internal logic without a dedicated task to surface this as a primary success criterion in the final report generation flow.

T006a is tagged with `[US1]`, but the task description states it is for 'CI bootstrapping' and 'synthetic data' which is 'ONLY for CI bootstrapping' and 'MUST be excluded from all final statistical reports'. This task does not directly implement a user story feature (US1 is about dynamic policy execution on real data). The tag `[US1]` is misleading as this is a setup/bootstrap task, not a US1 feature task. It should be untagged or tagged as a setup task.

T005a is tagged with `[US1]`, but it is a fallback logging task for when T006 is skipped. It does not implement a feature of US1 (dynamic policy). The tag `[US1]` is inappropriate for a bootstrap/fallback logging task that is not part of the core US1 functionality.

T008d is tagged with `[US1]`, but it is a fallback task for when T008 (ablation) fails. It generates mock data. While it supports the pipeline, it is not a direct implementation of the US1 feature (dynamic policy on real data). The tag `[US1]` is slightly misleading as it's a contingency task, not a core feature task.
